categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two main business segments: interconnect chip products and the JinDai® server platform product line. The interconnect chip products include memory interface chips (such as MRCD/MDB chips), memory module supporting chips, CKD chips, PCIe Retimer chips, and MXC chips. The JinDai® server platform consists of JinDai® CPUs and hybrid secure memory modules (HSDIMM®). Additionally, the company is developing AI chips to support AI training and inference workloads.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in integrated circuit design with proprietary technologies in digital signal processing, memory management, data buffering, analog circuit design, high-speed logic and interface circuits, and low-power design. It leads in DDR memory interface chip technology, including DDR4 and DDR5 generations, with innovations such as the '1+9' and '1+10' distributed buffer architectures adopted as JEDEC international standards. The company also develops high-speed SerDes IP for PCIe 5.0/CXL 2.0 Retimer chips and CXL memory expansion controllers. Manufacturing is outsourced under a fabless model, focusing on design and R&D while wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing are contracted out.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global memory manufacturers such as Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, who integrate the company's memory interface and supporting chips into server memory modules. The company's products serve cloud computing, data centers, AI servers, HPC, and enterprise servers. The JinDai® server platform targets the domestic Chinese market with applications in government, finance, transportation, and high-tech enterprises. The company also supplies PCIe Retimer chips to AI server and GPU manufacturers globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China, with a global presence including subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Macau, Hong Kong, and South Korea. Its sales and operations cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with a significant portion of revenue generated from overseas customers. The company maintains R&D and sales teams in key global technology hubs to engage with international industry leaders.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless integrated circuit design company. It focuses on chip design and development, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors. The company then sells finished chips to memory module manufacturers, server OEMs, and cloud service providers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining leadership in DDR5 memory interface chip technology and accelerating the development of next-generation DDR5 sub-generations. The company is heavily investing in high-performance interconnect chips such as PCIe 5.0/CXL 2.0 Retimers, MRCD/MDB chips for high-bandwidth memory modules, CKD chips for PC memory modules, and MXC chips for CXL memory expansion. It is also advancing its JinDai® server CPU platform and developing AI chips tailored for cloud data centers. R&D investment accounted for nearly 30% of revenue in 2023, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuit chips, including memory interface chips, interconnect chips, and server CPUs. The company also earns licensing fees from proprietary technologies and collects royalties. Sales are conducted mainly through direct sales channels to major memory manufacturers, server OEMs, and cloud service providers. The company follows a fabless model, focusing on design and selling finished chips rather than manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the global leaders in memory interface chips, competing with major players such as Renesas Electronics and Rambus. It is among the few suppliers worldwide capable of providing full DDR5 memory interface and supporting chip solutions. In PCIe Retimer chips, it is one of the top three global suppliers and the second company to mass-produce PCIe 5.0/CXL 2.0 Retimers. The company holds significant influence in JEDEC standard setting and maintains a strong competitive position in emerging CXL memory expansion markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.29 billion, a 37.76% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to global server and computer industry demand downturn and customer inventory reductions. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 450.9 million, down 65.3% year-over-year. Despite the decline, the company maintained positive cash flow from operations and increased R&D spending by 21%. The company has a registered capital of approximately RMB 1.14 billion and total assets around RMB 10.7 billion, reflecting a mid-sized semiconductor design firm with a focus on growth through innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary high-speed, low-power integrated circuit design technologies, enabling it to offer industry-leading DDR memory interface chips with superior performance and energy efficiency. It is a pioneer in DDR5 sub-generation chip development and a key contributor to international standards, ensuring compatibility and reliability. Its PCIe Retimer chips provide advanced signal integrity solutions critical for AI servers and high-performance computing. The JinDai® server platform offers secure, high-performance computing tailored for domestic markets. The company’s comprehensive product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities differentiate it as a technology leader in the AI and cloud computing era.
